subject: general
question: A right prism has a trapezium-shaped base with parallel sides 6 cm and 10 cm, height of trapezium 5 cm, and prism height 15 cm. Find the volume.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of prism = Base area × height

Base (trapezium) area = (1 ÷ 2) × (6 + 10) × 5 = 40 cm²

Volume = 40 × 15 = 600 cm³

**∴ Answer = 600 cm³**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Parallel sides = 6 cm, 10 cm

Height of trapezium = 5 cm

Height of prism = 15 cm

**Formula used:**

Area of trapezium = (1 ÷ 2) × (a + b) × h

Volume = Base area × prism height

 
 
 
• 
• 
• 
• 10 cm 6 cm 5 cm 15 cm 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area of base = (1 ÷ 2) × (6 + 10) × 5

⇒ = (1 ÷ 2) × 16 × 5 = 40 cm²

⇒ Volume = 40 × 15

⇒ Volume = 600 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 600 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Prism

Volume = Base area × height of prism

Area of Trapezium

Area = (1 ÷ 2) × (sum of parallel sides) × height

Special Shortcut

Volume = (1 ÷ 2) × (a + b) × h × prism height

Other Solids

Cylinder: Volume = πr²h | Cuboid: Volume = l × b × h
